what: An unchanged OpenSync pod onboarded by the RDK-B EasyMesh controller through EMOSA (doc/architecture/rdk-lab.md)
vm: rdk-emosa (rev120), built from the meta-cmf-bananapi-vcpe images of 2026-09-25 (controller X86EMLTRBPIBB_rdk-next_20260925030253, extender X86EMLTRBPIAP_rdk-next_20260925032259), layer 215535b
pod: pod-1, image mvx-pod-20260925002533 (opensync-lab with core patch 0002), serial MVXPOD023F87E628DD

steps.lan_port: bpibroadband eth2 (0a:e0:5a:00:00:01) in brlan0 over the VM bridge br-emosa; a test host leased 10.0.0.98 from 10.0.0.1
steps.gtp: em-gtp serves the pod's onboarding SSID opensync-lab-bhaul on channel 44 (virt-wlan105), underlay 169.254.2.1/25
steps.pod: joined the GTP, GRE g-bhaul-sta-50, br-home 10.0.0.155/24 from the RDK router; dialed its built-in redirector tcp:10.101.0.40:6640 (EMOSA's fleet) through the RDK router
steps.agent: AL 02:72:f9:7f:07:85 on agent port 6651; message set r1, multi_bss, m2_session shared; controller 00:60:2f:da:68:d4
steps.onboarding: the controller's five-BSS M2 set applied on the pod (OBSERVED_APPLIED): home-ap-24 private_ssid, svc-d-ap-24 iot_ssid, svc-e-ap-24 lnf_radius, fh-24 hotspot, b-ap-24 mesh_backhaul (Multi-AP backhaul BSS); 2.4 GHz channel 6
steps.controller_topology: Agent-1 02:72:f9:7f:07:85 with 5 BSSes and 1 station, Ethernet edge from the controller
steps.client: emc-1 (02:00:00:00:6c:00) on the pod's private_ssid, pinned to BSSID 82:00:00:00:6a:00: 10.0.0.52 from the RDK router, gateway and internet (ICMP and HTTP)
steps.client_steering: the controller's /usr/bin/steer.sh 02:00:00:00:6c:00 02:00:00:12:75:2c (a mandate, disassociation imminent) sent a Client Steering Request to the agent; EMOSA acknowledged it, opened a steering window on the pod (owm cs_state steering), wrote the directed kick; owm sent the BTM request naming 02:00:00:12:75:2c; the station left the pod's BSS and the window's rows were deleted. Eight runs on 2026-09-25 (pod image mvx-pod-20260925075828): seven ended left_source; one, sent while the agent was restarting, was not carried out. The client (wpa_supplicant 2.10) chose its next BSS itself: every link on this medium has the same SNR, and on a throughput tie it stays, so owm's deauthentication ended the association

fixed_on_the_way: opensync-lab core patch 0002: OSW writes only an ISO 3166 alpha-2 country_code (hwsim reported 99; hostapd rejected it and no BSS started)
emosa: frames not matching the agent's binding are dropped before the rate limit and without touching the session (the first M2 set was lost on the shared LAN)
meta-cmf 215535b: wmediumd includes guest containers' radios (user.wmediumd.guest=true)
opensync-lab daca9a9: owm client steering on hwsim (core 0003 BTM response age, hostapd ACL per phy, hostap 992 deny list keeps associated stations, hostap 993 assoc_ies)

EMOSA answers RDK's Channel Selection Request (other operating classes ignored, the 0 dBm power limit declined with code 2) and acknowledges its Multi-AP Policy Config Request with companions recorded as not applied: before, both went unanswered and the controller marked the pod's radio misconfigured
next: guests in the room model, so a steering target can be a better link than the pod
